description: Preview (may change before v0.10.0): Suggest reviewers per changed path from the highest-precedence CODEOWNERS file (last matching rule wins), active annotation owners, architecture-policy reviewers, and bounded .mailmap-canonical commit authors. Read-only: it never requests reviews or notifies anyone, prints names without @, and does not treat a name as evidence of identity, employment, or availability. Provide exactly one of report, diff, or workingTree.

diff.description: Git diff spec whose changed files are routed, such as main...HEAD

repo.description: Local checkout path (defaults to the MCP server repository)

report.description: Path to a saved FixMap JSON plan; its changed files (or ranked context files) are routed

workingTree.description: Route staged and unstaged changes against HEAD

name: fixmap_reviewers
title: FixMap reviewer suggestions
